summary: Astrotech filed an 8-K reporting an at-the-market offering agreement with H.C. Wainwright to sell up to $24.5M of common stock via an existing effective shelf registration (S-3). The terms are standard: a 3.0% commission, no obligation to sell, and termination upon full sale or agreement end. This is a routine capital-raising facility, not a special situation event. What to watch: ordinary shelf takedowns do not qualify as a special situation; there is no transaction event requiring risk-arb analysis.
